name_en: Bari–Cherry Cola charge deck (post-easing general deck)
ceiling: 35% to the end: 312-30 at 2.74G and 328-30 at 4.00–4.06G (GingerCraven; the 328-30 variant is stage-bari-coward-328). With Brightseeker it is also the deck of the documented 15% clears past 300 (301-27 and 301-28 at 2.05G, manual).
summary: The general stage deck since the 2026-09-23 easing: Brightseeker plus the two charge cookies Princess Bari and Cherry Cola do the damage, the Milk–Pomegranate–Macaron–Skating Queen–Cheesecake core buffs them, and Dark Choco and Moon Rabbit tank. ND러너's 'brainless' preset 5 is built on the same Cherry Cola, Bari and Strawberry Crepe core. It full-autos most 35% stages; it fails on bosses that hide behind adds or fake bosses, and on auto Cherry Cola can run ahead and drag Milk away.

cookies.why: Crit-rate buff: crit rate past 100% turns into extra hits, and pushers at 328 say damage doesn't land without Macaron and Cheesecake.
Rear-line dealer that stays on the boss; with Bari and Cherry Cola it is the trio credited with 'ripping 15%'. Stage practicality is quoted from 3★ (mid stages) and 5★ (201+).
Kept as the airborne counter so launch bosses don't disable the team, and for the power it carries (ND러너 tested removing it and calls that a detour). Moves to the bench for Scorpion on GingerCraven.
Support buffer that the 328 pushers call undroppable with Macaron; swapped for Herb on stages that check healing.
Skill AMP beam (빨대) that goes to the top-ATK cookies; it is why Milk's and the carries' ATK order is managed.
Buffer that stays in front and spends Bari's buff on the adds.
Charge dealer; its practicality on stages is quoted from 5★, and a 0–2★ Bari is swapped for Rye. Needs manual play on stages with a fake boss or adds behind the boss.
Captain and healer. Must hold the top ATK so Passion Pay (열정페이) and the captain bonus land on it; its buff reaches every cookie in a compact formation.
Second charge dealer. Two damage-reduction rune lines are enough (it dies easily); on auto it can run off and drag Milk away, so it belongs only in decks that also run Bari.
Second healer. Since the easing some pushers drop it for Rockstar or for damage, because stages now fail on damage rather than survival.
Tank with a DEF-shred debuff (needs focus to land) and a large share of team power ('뻥투용'); often sacrificed to the first hit.
Second tank that shares hits with Dark Choco; allowed to die once its debuff is on.

perks: Milk captain; 열정페이 + 초고속승진 at mercenary band Lv.4 (방어구 수리 특약 instead of 초고속승진 when survival fails).
substitutions: Launch bosses (Cool Mint, Werehound Princess, Tainted Ent, King Choco Drop): Panda Dumpling in the third pet slot.
Redberry Assassin packs: two melee cookies out for Jungle Warrior (or Tiger Lily) and Rye, or switch to stage-aoe-rapidfire.
Low-star Bari: Rye in its slot.
Scorpion in for Pinot Noir or Herb on boss stages (the 312-30 clear ran Scorpion).
Rockstar for Herb at the bottom of 35% on mid stages.
rng: Auto pathing: Cherry Cola runs ahead on auto. Bari's damage needs the boss exposed.
unorthodox: No dedicated tank line beyond Dark Choco and Moon Rabbit: survival is traded for damage since the easing.

name_en: Brightseeker all-in-one deck with per-boss swaps (pre-easing)
name_kr: 168 이후 All In One 단일 덱
ceiling: Before the easing: every stage from 169 at 35% on full auto (10–20 tries) except the three Rowdy Bikers and GingerCraven, which the author took at 55%; truck cleared at 816M. After the easing the same core pushes on auto (266-30 Cool Mint at 1.17G in a close variant).
summary: 그드득's one-deck guide for stages after 168: Milk captain with Passion Pay, the Pomegranate beam steered onto Rye, Brightseeker on the boss, Cake Hound and Dark Choco for the three-tank Armor Repair perk, and per-boss swaps (Scorpion for Rye, Ion for Strawberry Crepe, Panda Dumpling for launch bosses). Skating Queen and Cherry Cola are held one or two levels low so Milk keeps the top ATK.
